race.description: King Of Swing Standing At Cobbitty Equine Farm Trotters Mbl
race.comment: EZRA KAI (9) was let down by manners last start so he'll need to get this right but showed his ability in winning three back at this circuit. Prepared to give him another chance. CALL ME JACK (3) was held up late when fourth to a handy one last start, beaten 4.3 metres. Winner three back at this circuit and distance. A nice draw should ensure a cosy run. Big chance. SHOULD BEABARCA (4) was solid in finishing fourth from a 20m handicap at his most recent appearance here and overcame a back row draw to score at Goulburn prior. Contender. VALTINO (10) draws wide but could be close to a win having overcome a break for third last time, his second placing from his last three outings here.
